title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets Defensive Player of the Year trophy in 'disrespectful' mishap

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba gets Defensive Player of the Year trophy in 'disrespectful' mishap
sources.description: The NFL gave Jaxon Smith-Njigba a trophy labeling him as the league's 2025 Defensive Player of the Year, a mishap the young WR called "disrespectful."
